title: DART SPICE kernel collection

links.label: PDS registry record of the DART SPICE bundle
NAIF holdings of the kernel collection

publisher: NASA Planetary Data System, Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility

statements.text: Nair, H., Costa Sitja, M. and Bailey, A. M. (2025), DART SPICE Kernel Archive Bundle, NASA Planetary Data System, urn:nasa:pds:dart.spice::4.0.
statements.scope: Every kernel in the pinned set: leap seconds, planetary and Didymos-system constants, DART and Didymos frames, the DRACO instrument kernel, the spacecraft clock, DE430, the Didymos-system and DART ephemerides, structures, and the terminal-approach pointing.
statements.evidence: Citation_Information of the bundle label bundle_dart_spice_v004.xml.

statements.text: NASA public scientific data; retain the bundle citation and source notices.
statements.scope: Derived camera geometry and its evidence.

statements.text: Kernel versions differ from those the DRACO backplane cubes cite (spc_v03 pointing, s527 system ephemeris, didymos_system_12 constants), which are not in the archived collection; the pinned v04/s542/15 set moves the DRACO frame by under half a pixel relative to the archived intercepts.
statements.scope: Cross-validation of the kernel-derived DRACO camera against the archived backplanes.
statements.evidence: geom:SPICE_Kernel_Identification of the cube label and the Dimorphos README residuals.
